Bill Tracker Pro is the #1 app for tracking bills, income, and spending. Connect your bank, create a budget, track your cash flow, and take control of your finances.

New in Bill Tracker Pro:

Connect your Apple Card and automatically bring your transactions, balances, and spending activity into the app from Apple Wallet.

Bank Sync with Plaid – Connect your accounts to sync transactions automatically.

Know What’s Safe to Spend – See your real-time spending power after upcoming bills.

Never Miss a Bill – Set reminders, view your upcoming bills at a glance, and stay organized with widgets.

Find Hidden Subscriptions – Uncover forgotten recurring charges by linking your bank or card.

Budget Your Way – Create flexible budgets that work with your lifestyle.

Budget with your partner - Invite your partner to join you and share your finances together.

Manual or Auto—You Choose – Log expenses yourself or let the app track them for you.

Visual Insights – Analyze your finances with charts, reports, and summaries.

Privacy First – Protect your data with Face ID, Touch ID, and encrypted syncing.

Whether you want to pay bills on time, build savings, or reduce spending — Bill Tracker Pro makes it simple.

Other Features:

Create recurring bills with flexible schedules (e.g. every 3 weeks, quarterly, custom days).

Get rich push notifications with due date charts and the ability to mark bills as paid.

Calendar view with payment statuses and category grouping.

Analyze your spending with daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly charts.

Track percentage changes in spending over time.

Pie charts that highlight top spending categories.

Manage your accounts, view current balances, and forecast future balances.

See your full financial picture with cash flow and net balance indicators.

Export bills and income transactions to CSV.

Log partial or full bill payments, with full payment history.

Auto Pay Bill feature that automatically marks recurring bills as paid.

Customize notification time, sounds, currency, and authentication preferences.

Secure access with passcode, Face ID, or Touch ID.

Simple, intuitive design built for clarity and speed.

SUBSCRIPTION AND PRICING TERMS

Bill Tracker Pro offers auto-renewing subscriptions for premium access. Payment is charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the current period ending. Prices may vary by region.

You can cancel anytime through your iTunes settings. Cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal to avoid being charged.

it.name: Moneycontrol - Markets & News
it.d:
Moneycontrol App is Asia's #1 App for Business & Finance - Track markets, get loans, do financial transactions, and more.

Track the latest updates on Indian and Global financial markets on your smartphone with the Moneycontrol App. It covers multiple assets from BSE, NSE, MCX and NCDEX exchanges, so you can track Indices (Sensex & Nifty), Stocks, Futures, Options, Mutual Funds, Commodities and Currencies with ease. Additionally, the app facilitates personal loans and fixed deposits.

Monitor your investments with Portfolio and Watchlist. Stay updated with the wide range of news covered in our News and Personal Finance sections. Get expert’s views, in-depth coverage and analysis of the financial markets with live streaming of CNBC AWAAZ (Hindi), CNBC BAJAR (Gujarati) and CNBC PRIME HD.

Here’s what you can expect from the Moneycontrol App.

Seamless Navigation:
•	Effortlessly browse your portfolio, markets data, latest news, watchlist, forum, and more.
Latest Market Data:
•	Latest quotes and in-depth market stats of stocks, F&O, mutual funds, commodities and currencies from BSE, NSE, MCX and NCDEX
•	Latest prices of Sensex, NIFTY, India VIX and more
•	Interactive and historical charts such as Line, Area, Candlestick and OHLC 
News:
•	Stay informed with the latest market, business, and economy news.
•	Enjoy exclusive interviews with top business leaders.
•	Use the ‘Text to Speech’ feature to listen to news and articles on the go.
Portfolio:
•	Easily monitor your portfolio across stocks, mutual funds, and other assets.
Personalized Watchlist:
•	Track your favourite stocks, mutual funds, commodities, futures effortlessly.
Forum Message Board:
•	Engage with your favorite topics and follow top boarders for insights.


Moneycontrol Pro Offers:
‣ Ad-free Experience
‣ Personalized News for your portfolio
‣ Insights, Analysis, and Trends with sharp commentary to help make better investment decisions
‣ Ideas for Profit from our in-house and independent research team
‣ Technical Analysis by professional chartists
‣ Smart Calendar of business and economic events
‣ Guru Speak - lessons from successful investors

Household account management is complicated. But we make it simple by simplifying the things that are complex.  The default settings will get you started, and once you get used to it, you can alter the settings according to your needs with the highly flexible and customizable functions available. 

- Super easy and simple to enter data anytime, anywhere.
- View your spending tendencies graphically.
- View statistics by simply entering the data.
- Search and calculator functions.
- Set up sub-categories and main categories as necessary.
- Manage all your accounts at once.
- Use multiple currencies.
- Check weekly, monthly, and annual statistics.
- Use the calendar view.
- Use budget planning features to plan weekly, monthly, and annual budgets.
- Change the start date of the month.

※ Applying double entry bookkeeping
It facilitates efficient account management. Automatic double entry bookkeeping.

※ PC manager function
You can view ‘“Money Manager” application using Wi-Fi.  You can edit and sort the data by date, category or account group on the screen of your PC. In addition, you can see fluctuations of your accounts indicated on graphs on your PC.
 
※ Budget management function
You can manage your budget. It shows your budget and expenditures on a graph so you can compare a number of your expenditures against your budget quickly.
 
※ Credit Card / Debit Card management function
When entering a future payment date, you can see the payment amount and outstanding balance on the accounts page. You can connect your debit card to your accounts so that expenses are automatically recorded under a specific account.
 
 ※ Passcode
You can specify the desired time lapse before the app requests a passcode.
 
※ Automatic money transfer and frequency functions
You can set up automatic money transfers between your accounts and configure the frequency of those transfers.
 
※ Sort expenses by the recipient
You can sort your expenses by the recipient and view this information graphically.
 
※ Payment Profiles
You can easily enter frequent expenditures by creating payment profiles.
 
※ Backup / Restore
You can backup and restore your data via email, iTunes and iCloud. 

※ Multiple currency support – you can have individual entries in multiple currencies, and configure each account to calculate the total balance in your desired currency.

> HELPS YOU KNOW HOW MUCH TO SPEND
Pennies does all the hard work for you by telling you how much you have to spend today. If you spend less, no worries, Pennies will give you more money to spend tomorrow.

> HELPS YOU SAVE MONEY 
Should you spend or should you save? Pennies shows your spending and finance health with bold colors, helping you slow down or speed up your spending to keep you on track.

> MORE PERSONAL THAN ANY OTHER BUDGETING APP
Pennies offers you weekly, monthly, bi-weekly, twice-monthly, custom and one-off budgets, that start on any day you want. No other budgeting app gives you this much flexibility to create budgets that work perfectly with your lifestyle.

> INSTANTLY SYNC VIA ICLOUD
Keep your budgets backed up and shared across all your iOS devices via iCloud. Pennies installs on your iPhone, Watch and iPad and seamlessly syncs your budgets for you.

> AS MANY BUDGETS AS YOU NEED 
Have more than one budget that you want to keep on top of? No problem, there's no limit to how many budgets you can set up.

> FLEXIBLE EXPENSES 
Sometimes we forget when we spend – that’s OK. Add and edit expenses to previous dates and budget periods, and Pennies will recalculate your budgets today so you are always up to date with your spending money.

> MULTIPLE CURRENCIES
Use any currency in the world for individual budgets.

> TRANSFER BETWEEN BUDGETS
Easily transfer money between budgets with a single click.

Made a purchase? Sweet, just add it in. Pennies only cares about the numbers, no tags, charts or complex breakdowns here. Just the amount of money you have to spend is all you need to know.

> 3D TOUCH SUPPORT
Add budgets, transfers and expenses straight from your home screen using 3D Touch Quick Actions. Requires iPhone 6s / 6s+

> TODAY WIDGET SUPPORT 
Head to the Today view in Notification Center and add Pennies Today, you'll get a handy view of your daily budgets, and with a single tap you can view them in Pennies.

> BUDGETS ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
Pennies comes ready to install on your iPhone, iPad and your Apple Watch, so you can keep your budget with you wherever you go!


Budgeting shouldn’t be hard work or boring. That’s why in Pennies you won’t find any charts, graphs or complicated diagrams. It's personal finance made easy, it’s your money made simple.

Pennies is friendly, bold and unbelievably easy to use, giving you the freedom to manage your budgets and spending in any way that suits you. It's all about keeping things easy and flexible so you can get on with having fun, spending what you want, and saving money at the end of the month. 

So, start budgeting how you want, when you want, without any worry. Start using Pennies today!

Welcome to Accountit, a simple, but powerful daily transactions tracker that will definitely help you get a full picture of your finances. With Accountit, tracking and organizing all of your transactions becomes as effortless as possible, all thanks to the useful features that the app has on offer.

Accountit lets you add an unlimited number of transactions that can be organized into different categories that you can create and customize yourself. With Accountit, you can also filter and organize all of your transactions even more efficiently using tags that you can create and assign to any of your transactions in the app.

Don’t worry if you have any recurring transactions because we have got you covered too! Just mark a transaction as recurring and set the frequency when adding it, Accountit will handle the rest for you and you won’t need to manually add the same exact transactions every single time. With Accountit, you can also add various attachments, such as receipts, to your transactions in no time at all because you can scan receipts and take photos directly in the app. One of the main goals of the app is to help you quickly analyze all of your transactions and this is why Accountit offers a dedicated Summary screen that displays an extensive variety of information based on your transactions.

Accountit is built with privacy and security in mind and it just doesn’t collect any personal data that can be linked to you. All of your data in the app is stored locally on your device and synced via iCloud if you have enabled this functionality in the settings of the app. We have designed Accountit to be as intuitive and easy to use as possible and it will definitely feel right at home on any of your Apple devices, all thanks to its native design.

Accountit offers an extensive variety of features that you can use completely for free, but if you feel that the free functionality isn’t enough for your needs, you can always upgrade to Accountit Plus for even better experience. - Ability to add notes to your transactions

- Bulk editing

hey bestie, ready to make budgeting effortless? with budget bestie, you can take full control of your money on your own terms—whether you get paid weekly, biweekly, twice a month, or monthly, we’ve got you covered. using the cash stuffing method, you’ll say goodbye to stress and hello to a budgeting approach that fits your life perfectly.

okay but what’s cash stuffing?

1. create envelopes – create an envelope for each expense category like food, eating out, rent
2. stuff your envelopes – put all of your cash into envelopes based on how much you’ll spend before you get paid again
3. spend your money – this is the fun part - don’t feel guilty for spending your hard earned money. when you buy something, use the cash from the corresponding envelope
4. get paid, repeat - record your income (cha-ching) and go back to step 2, stuff your envelopes

how budget bestie works

- no need to carry cash - we’ve taken this 100+ year old proven technique and put it in your iPhone
- say bye to math and spreadsheets - we’ll recommend how much to stuff into each envelope based on previous spending habits and upcoming bills
- avoid late fees by getting reminded - we’ll send you a notification when you haven’t recorded paying a recurring expense
- hit your savings goals - create savings envelopes and we’ll make sure you’re on track to hit your goals
- budget on your schedule - whether it’s weekly, biweekly, twice a month, or monthly, you can budget based on what works for you

• Investors building and monitoring portfolios

REAL-TIME MARKET DATA
Track live stock market data, prices, charts, and movements for 300,000+ instruments — stocks, ETFs, indices, commodities, currencies, bonds, crypto, and futures. FINANCIAL NEWS & ANALYSIS

ADVANCED CHARTS & TECHNICAL ANALYSIS

CUSTOM PRICE ALERTS

INVESTING.COM PRO
Upgrade to Investing.com Pro for an ad-free experience, exclusive financial data, advanced stock screeners, extended historical data, deeper market analysis tools, and priority access to new features. A free version of the app is available with full access to core features.

• ETFs & mutual funds
• Crypto, including Bitcoin, Ethereum & altcoins
• Forex (170+ currency pairs)
• Commodities like gold, silver, oil & natural gas

Investing.com is a financial data and research platform used by investors and traders in over 200 countries. The app is available in 30+ languages.

TradeTracker is a trading journal application designed to record, organize, and analyze trading operations across different markets.

ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) ANALYSIS

TradeTracker integrates an AI analysis feature that automatically generates personalized performance reports based on recorded trading data. The AI identifies patterns across symbols, sessions, timeframes, and market types, providing structured insights directly within the application. Analyses are available on a daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual basis. All AI-generated content is strictly analytical — no financial advice is provided.

KEY FEATURES

The application includes a calendar that allows users to visualize all executed trades over a given period to track trading activity over time. It also provides an equity curve chart to analyze overall performance and progression.

Each transaction can be recorded with several parameters, including:
• symbol
• order type
• time frame
• execution details and potential errors

It is also possible to attach a screenshot to each trade. All fields are fully customizable, allowing users to add their own parameters based on their trading methodology.

MANAGEMENT AND STATISTICS

TradeTracker includes an automatic risk-reward calculator applied to each trade, as well as multi-account management, allowing users to create an unlimited number of accounts (live, demo, or prop firm).

Detailed statistics are available for each account:
• total P&L and average P&L
• win rate
• average risk-reward ratio
• number of winning trades
• number of losing trades
• number of break-even trades

ADVANCED TOOLS

Users can also create custom filters to analyze their trading journal in greater depth, for example, to identify recurring losses, recurring gains, or to focus on specific setups.
